Role Description
As a Software Engineer on the Metadata team, you’ll build and operate the large-scale distributed databases that every Dropbox service depends on. Metadata systems are mission-critical, in the live path for all user operations and must meet stringent requirements for latency, durability, and transactional consistency.
You’ll design and evolve the core infrastructure that manages Dropbox’s databases at scale, enabling fast, reliable access to data for millions of users and hundreds of internal services. This work spans distributed systems, replication, caching, and transactional database systems.
You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across Infrastructure and Product teams to ensure the metadata layer meets business needs and continues to scale with Dropbox’s growth. This is an opportunity to leverage your expertise in distributed systems and grow into broader technical leadership.
Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here .

Design and maintain distributed database systems providing low-latency, strongly consistent data access
Implement and optimize replication, consensus, and caching mechanisms to meet availability and performance goals
Operate production systems, including participating in the on-call rotation, ensuring high availability and data durability
Collaborate with infrastructure and product teams to assess current and future use cases and requirements, supporting the development of a mid- to long-term roadmap that reflects these needs
Contribute to system design reviews, postmortems, and reliability improvements
Write high-quality, efficient code in Go and Rust for performance-critical systems
On-call work may be necessary occasionally to help address bugs, outages, or other operational issues, with the goal of maintaining a stable and high-quality experience for our customers.

5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong expertise in distributed systems fundamentals including replication, consistency, partitioning, and fault tolerance
Experience building database platforms, distributed databases, storage systems, or large-scale database infrastructure
Proficiency in Go, Rust, C++ or similar systems languages
Familiarity with consensus and coordination systems (e.g. Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd)
Experience operating production services and participating in on-call rotations
Strong debugging and performance analysis skills
Excellent collaboration and communication abilities across teams

Experience building distributed databases or storage systems
Practical experience with and deep understanding of data structures used in storage systems (e.g. LSM trees, B-trees, Hash Indexes)
Experience operating database systems (e.g. MySQL, Postgres, Cassandra)
Experience with distributed caching, either custom built or operating open source options such as Memcached or Redis
Experience improving reliability and performance in high-scale data systems
Experience working with cross-functional teams to understand their current use cases, identify future needs and requirements, and incorporate them into the team’s roadmap.
Interest in deepening distributed systems expertise and expanding technical leadership

Staff Software Engineer

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be the founding engineer for a new functional team that owns glab, GitLab’s Go-based command-line interface (CLI) and a key part of our Developer Clients strategy. You’ll guide its technical direction end to end, owning architecture, implementation, roadmap execution, and day-to-day technical choices.

You’ll serve a highly technical developer audience and an engaged open source community while working as a self-directed staff engineer in an IC role with minimal guidance.
You’ll work within the Developer Clients group in GitLab’s AI Clients stage, collaborating with engineers across the GitLab Duo CLI and integrated development environment (IDE) extensions. The role is based in Bangalore..

Guide the technical direction of glab, owning its architecture, implementation, and evolution.
Design and ship terminal-first features and workflows in Go, with close attention to developer experience, performance, scripting-friendly output, and backwards compatibility.
Absorb multiple changing inputs from Product, the open source community, and internal teams, re-prioritize as needs change, and keep shipping iterative improvements.
Partner with Product Management to shape and execute the roadmap by framing problems, making clear trade-offs, and turning feedback into focused, high-impact changes.
Steer the open source project and community by triaging issues, reviewing and merging contributions, upholding a high quality bar, and saying no respectfully while keeping contributors engaged.
Work with other Developer Clients teams, including GitLab Duo CLI and IDE extensions, so glab works well with the broader GitLab developer experience and common capabilities.
Contribute to TypeScript- or JavaScript-based developer tools when features or common components span multiple Developer Clients teams.
Establish engineering practices for the new functional team and track glab adoption, release quality, and open source community health metrics to guide roadmap and engineering choices.

Significant professional experience with Go and building command-line interfaces or systems-level tools, including thoughtful command and flag design, clear terminal experiences, scripting-friendly output, backwards compatibility, and distribution across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
A sustained history of open source contributions through issues, merge requests, and reviews, ideally including project triage or maintainership.
Proven ability to operate as a self-directed owner who can absorb multiple and frequently changing inputs, re-prioritize with discretion, and continue delivering.
Strong product and user experience instincts for developer workflows, including the ability to frame problems, simplify scope, make clear trade-offs, and say no or "not yet" when it improves the overall experience.a
Experience setting technical direction and influencing work across teams in an IC role.
Experience collaborating transparently across teams in a remote, asynchronous environment.
Additional experience with TypeScript or JavaScript developer tools, AI-powered developer tools or agents, and plugin or extensibility architectures.
A background in developer tooling, such as CLIs, SDKs, internal platforms, CI/CD, or IDE integrations, is preferred.
Familiarity with AI coding assistants (GitLab Duo, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools) as part of a modern developer toolkit.

We are about nine engineers in the Developer Clients group and part of the AI Clients stage, which has about 20 engineers. We work across the GitLab CLI, GitLab Duo CLI, and JetBrains and Visual Studio Code IDE extensions. We operate as a broader team, hold a weekly sync, and encourage engineers to collaborate across team boundaries.

* Du wirst Teil eines agilen Teams, das nach SAFe oder Scrum arbeitet und gemeinsam daran wächst, Prozesse, Zusammenarbeit und Qualität kontinuierlich zu verbessern

* Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Fachbereich
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, vorzugsweise Embedded-Software
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C/C++ sowie Erfahrung mit objektorientiertem Softwaredesign und Softwarearchitekturen
* Erfahrung über den gesamten Software-Lebenszyklus - von der Anforderungsanalyse über Design und Implementierung bis hin zu Test, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung
* Freude daran, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, Architekturentscheidungen mitzugestalten und nachhaltige Softwarelösungen zu entwickeln
* Hoher Qualitätsanspruch, analytisches Denken sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Analyste, Développeur ou Développeuse fullstack \- 100%
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
La Direction de la Transformation Numérique et de l’Intelligence Augmentée (DTN\-IA) créée, intègre et gère toutes les applications informatiques d'un des systèmes d'information hospitalier les plus performants afin de soutenir les activités cliniques et logistiques des Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève.

Avec un parc de plus de 12'500 postes, 1'300 serveurs pour plus de 250 applications au service de l'ensemble du personnel, disponible 24h/24h et 7j/7j, la DTN\-IA gère un système d'information RH pour les 13'000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs des HUG et des 7 autres institutions genevoises et un ERP performant pour les processus logistiques et financiers des plus complexes.
La DTN\-IA crée un dossier patient informatisé à la pointe du secteur et participe au rayonnement des HUG grâce à une richesse fonctionnelle reconnue et des collaborations étroites avec tous les professionnels et professionnelles de santé et leurs directions transverses. Par ailleurs, la DTN\-IA intègre des équipements biomédicaux de pointe et du quotidien ainsi que des applications spécialisées pour tous les plateaux médico\-techniques.
Le métier de la DTN\-IA est de soutenir les activités quotidiennes et de bâtir le futur d'un hôpital moderne et performant, selon les axes stratégiques de l'institution en s'appuyant sur les meilleures pratiques et les standards les plus exigeants.
Analyste, Développeur ou Développeuse fullstack \- 100%
Intégrez et renforcez une équipe composée de 2 développeurs fullstack et un lead développeur, dont la mission est de poursuivre le développement et l’évolution de l’application Greco, le logiciel de gestion de planning et de téléconsultation utilisé par le personnel.

Le logiciel est également utilisé par les patients et patientes grâce à l’application Concerto. L’équipe travaille de manière agile en s’inspirant fortement de la méthodologie Scrum tout en s’adaptant aux contraintes liées au milieu hospitalier qui impliquent d’être capable de parfois devoir changer rapidement de tâche pour s’adapter aux priorités.
Vous participez à la rédaction des cahiers des charges techniques, en traduisant les besoins fonctionnels en spécifications détaillées. À partir des spécifications techniques, vous développez le logiciel, aussi bien sur la partie front\-end que back\-end, en utilisant les technologies de pointe et une architecture microservices.

Vous faites évoluer la solution et garantissez sa maintenance, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux. Concrètement, vous développez en autonomie les fonctionnalités et corrections qui vous sont attribuées.
Grâce à votre esprit d’équipe, vous collaborez étroitement avec l’équipe pour développer des solutions et des fonctionnalités fiables et évolutives. Vous partagez les meilleures pratiques et adoptez une approche critique et constructive dans une optique d’amélioration continue en faisant preuve d’une forte orientation solution.
Tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, grâce à votre sens de la communication, vous contribuez au développement du logiciel de manière optimale et structurée, assurant un lien essentiel avec les coordinateurs et coordinatrices greco des différents départements médicaux.

Vous adaptez votre langage en fonction de vos interlocuteurs et interlocutrices pour vulgariser les termes techniques, challengez les solutions proposées, et collaborez activement avec les parties prenantes pour trouver les adaptations les plus pertinentes.
De plus, vous veillez à la mise à jour et à la rédaction de la documentation nécessaire. Vous mettez à profit votre capacité de synthèse et votre pragmatisme pour mener votre mission dans les délais impartis et garantir un résultat de qualité.
Vous participez activement à l’ensemble des phases d'un projet informatique, de son initialisation à sa finalisation, en vous assurant de produire les livrables attendus à chacune de ces phases. En outre, vous assurez également le support utilisateurs de niveau 3, en relation avec les autres services de la DTN\-IA, tout en assurant une orientation client forte.

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en informatique ou d'un diplôme jugé équivalent, et vous justifiez d’une expérience d’au moins cinq ans dans une fonction de développement fullstack en contact avec le métier.
Vous maîtrisez une architecture microservices avec les technologies Java/J2EE avec le Framework Spring, en particulier Spring Boot, Spring Data r2dbc, Spring cloud stream et Spring Security, mais également OAuth2, Hibernate et SQL (Oracle, PostgreSQL). Vous avez effectué de nombreux tests unitaires et d'intégration, avec les outils de test Junit5 et Mockito. Une connaissance de l’architecture microservices orienté évènement avec la solution Kafka constitue un atout important.
Pour la partie frontend, vous détenez une expertise sur Angular avec la version 20 idéalement.
Vous savez utiliser les outils de collaboration (GIT, JIRA et Confluence) ainsi que les outils de construction Maven et Docker. Une connaissance approfondie des méthodes agiles, notamment Scrum, constitue un atout.
Vous faites preuve d’une excellente capacité relationnelle dans les environnements pluridisciplinaires, alliant communication, vulgarisation des termes techniques et écoute active pour garantir la compréhension des besoins.
Vous savez prendre du recul et tirer parti des retours d'expérience pour progresser. Votre sens de l’initiative est un atout précieux pour le développement de solutions innovantes.
Vous faites preuve d’organisation, d’un bon sens relationnel et d’autonomie dans la recherche de solutions. Par ailleurs, vous avez démontré votre capacité d’initiative et vous souhaitez relever des défis dans un environnement exigeant et de grande technicité.

The Spatial AI Lab is part of Microsoft’s Applied Sciences Group, which develops next-generation human-computer interaction technologies using advances in AI, hardware, and device design. Our scientists and engineers specialize in computer vision, multimodal AI, spatial and embodied AI, robotics, and cloud services.
We are looking for a software engineer to develop intelligent systems and experiences for emerging agents. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, students, and external research partners across applied research, rapid prototyping, and product development. The work may span AI models, robotics, hardware and software integration, developer tools, data and evaluation systems, and scalable product capabilities.
Our technical focus evolves frequently, so you should be comfortable with ambiguity, learning new technologies, and applying strong software engineering skills across research and product challenges. You may also collaborate with academic partners such as ETH Zurich, contribute to research publications and demonstrations, and mentor students.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Design, implement, test, and maintain software for intelligent systems, prototypes, and product experiences.
Collaborate with scientists, engineers, and students to translate research ideas and early prototypes into robust implementations.
Develop and integrate components involving areas such as multimodal AI, computer vision, spatial computing, embodied AI, robotics, data processing, simulation, or hardware integration.
Evaluate system behavior, investigate technical issues, and improve performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Apply modern engineering practices, including code reviews, automated testing, documentation, security, privacy, and responsible AI.
Contribute effectively in a multidisciplinary environment with evolving goals and technical requirements.

Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or a related technical field OR equivalent experience.
Experience developing software in one or more programming languages, including but not limited to C++, C#, Python.
Ability to collaborate across disciplines and learn unfamiliar technologies.

Experience in one or more relevant areas, such as AI or machine learning, computer vision, robotics, simulation, spatial computing, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
Experience integrating software with machine-learning models, sensors, devices, or other complex systems.
Experience taking experimental or research-oriented software toward a reliable and maintainable implementation.
Familiarity with modern development practices and tools, including automated testing, continuous integration, debugging, profiling, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Experience collaborating in research, academic, or multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes.

The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases.

The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.
The Simulation ML Infrastructure team builds scalable AI/ML infrastructure to accelerate the Simulator team in sustainably innovating and building state of the art simulations of realistic environments for the testing and training of the Waymo Driver.

To increase the fidelity and steerability of the simulations, we employ large foundation models trained on massive datasets to model the real world, including but not limited to, realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists etc.), roads, traffic control systems, and weather etc.
We seek an experienced Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer to lead the development of advanced AI/ML infrastructure for multi-billion parameter foundation models in ML accelerator-friendly simulations. Your expertise in massive model scaling, ML accelerators, and distributed training will be required for designing and scaling our systems.
This role reports to an Engineering Manager.

Be part of a world-class, high-performing research engineering team to advance the state of the art of ultra realistic multi-agent simulations using foundation models.
Collaborate closely with the core Google DeepMind and Waymo Realism Modeling teams in London, and Waymo Oxford to use the large models to improve sim realism.
Provide deep technical leadership on large-scale ML model architectures, especially for autonomous vehicle models. Work at the intersection of data engineering, model development, and deployment, and provide guidance on architectural decisions and technical directions. Own large, complex systems, driving architectures that meet technical and business objectives.
Design and scale large distributed systems covering the ML lifecycle, supporting planet-scale dataset generation and model training.
Collaborate cross-functionally to derive performance and system-level requirements for large ML systems. Translate product/business goals into measurable technical deliverables, ensuring system component alignment.
Mentor junior engineers, growing their expertise and fostering a collaborative culture.

BS in Computer Science, Robotics, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in machine learning infrastructure such as developing, scaling, training, deploying, and optimizing large-scale machine learning systems from data to model.

MS in Computer Science, Robotics, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in machine learning infrastructure such as developing, designing, scaling, training, deploying, and optimizing large-scale machine learning systems from data to model.
Solid experience in the development and optimization of machine learning infrastructure tools like DeepSpeed, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
Strong expertise in distributed training techniques, including gradient sharding and optimization strategies for scaling large models across ML accelerator profiling tools to uncover performance bottlenecks.
Deep understanding of state-of-the-art machine learning models such as auto-regressive transformers and familiarity with custom-kernels for diverse h/w compute based efficiency.
Practical familiarity in Autonomous Driving, Simulations, and ML accelerators is a huge plus.

By joining Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
The Data Developer Experience team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build core services for our Data Platform. The team builds the Data Control Plane, a Go-based internal Terraform- or Kubernetes-like platform which allows users and other services to configure and operate Data Platform infrastructure.
Our mission is to meet the massive data scaling needs of a global organization with a platform that is simple yet powerful, self-healing, agentic-safe, trustworthy, snappy, and cost efficient.
What you'll be doing
Designing - you align our ambitions and stakeholder needs on a feature level. You collaborate with the team to propose well fitting solutions using RFCs.
Building - you develop Go code with agents. The implementation may target a backend service, our plugin framework, CLI tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or even our React frontend app.
Documenting - you ensure high quality, curated markdown documentation for users, AI agents, and maintainers / on-call.
Operating - you strive for operational excellence with constant vigilance, proactivity, and on-call participation to ensure we provide a robust platform for business critical workloads.
Supporting - you understand the needs of diverse data platform users and guide them to golden paths.
Our humble expectations
You have a proven track record of designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and/or platforms.
You bring deep experience with Go, but you possess a polyglot mindset and are happy to dive into Python or other languages when the problem calls for it.
You have hands-on experience building, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines.
You possess a strong foundational understanding of networking and security best practices.
You are familiar with data platform architecture and technologies, specifically columnar databases/storage and MPP engines.
You are passionate about Developer Experience and excel at balancing user needs with technical and platform constraints.
You actively leverage agentic coding as your preferred workflow to accelerate value delivery, while maintaining the critical eye needed to rigorously vet and secure code for robust systems.
What's in it for you
A rare opportunity to join a near-greenfield project building state-of-the-art, robust, scalable foundations for the future.
Work in a Big Tech-adjacent environment with brilliant colleagues, modern tooling and practices, and large scale.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
